result.instructions: Tools for Klaviyo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my lists grew the most this month?"; "Show me the live flows and their status."; "Find the profile for alice@example.com and list the lists she is in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Klaviyo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run klaviyo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run klaviyo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run klaviyo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. klaviyo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Klaviyo account the private API key belongs to (name, contact information, industry, timezone). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/accounts.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the account's lists (static audiences used for sends, flow triggers and signup forms), with names and creation dates. GET /api/lists.

filter.description: Klaviyo filter, e.g. equals(name,"Newsletter") or contains(name,"VIP"). Allowed fields depend on the resource.

page_cursor.description: page[cursor] value taken from links.next of the previous reply.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. name or -created (a leading - sorts descending).

tools.name: klaviyo_create_list
tools.title: Create list
tools.description: Create a new empty list with the given name. Creates a record only; it sends nothing. POST /api/lists.

tools.name: klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list
tools.title: Add profiles to list
tools.description: Add existing profiles to a list by profile id (max 100 per call). Does not change consent. Adding a profile can trigger flows that start on list membership. POST /api/lists/{id}/relationships/profiles.

tools.name: klaviyo_create_profile
tools.title: Create profile
tools.description: Create a profile (contact) from email, phone, names, external id and custom properties. It does not subscribe the contact to marketing. Klaviyo returns 409 if the profile exists. POST /api/profiles.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +15555550100.

external_id.description: Your own id for this contact.

tools.name: klaviyo_update_profile
tools.title: Update profile
tools.description: Update the given fields of one profile by id. Fields you omit stay unchanged. PATCH /api/profiles/{id}.

phone_number.description: New phone number in E.164 format.
